messages:
Mina (Design): Noticing an odd interaction on narrow phones: when users swipe the left panel closed quickly, the table header sometimes snaps twice and the first row gets hidden under the toolbar. Repro on iPhone SE width.
Theo (Product): Thanks — any recent CSS changes to sticky headers?
Ivy (Frontend): We recently added dynamic toolbar height calculation. Looks like the debounce for measuring offset is too short, so a fast collapse triggers a reflow loop.
Carlos (Mobile): On Android WebView the swipe gesture emits multiple touch events; the collapse animation is interrupted and header sticky top gets a stale offset.
Mina (Design): UX asks: can we avoid the double-snap jank? Also suggest making the toolbar collapse smoother and keep the first row visible.
Ivy (Frontend): Plan: increase debounce to 150ms and during transition set `pointer-events: none` on the body to avoid intermediate touches. Also set toolbar container height explicitly to avoid layout shifts.
Carlos (Mobile): Add `will-change: transform` on the toolbar and use transform-based translateY for animations to keep it on the compositor. That reduces jank in WebView.
Theo (Product): Accessibility: ensure when the panel collapses we announce "Navigation collapsed" and focus doesn't move unexpectedly. Also keep hit targets >=44px.
A11y-Bot: Reminder: add `aria-live="polite"` announcement and ensure overflow menu triggers have `aria-haspopup`/`aria-expanded`. Contrast checks flagged for the compact toolbar icon color (target 4.5:1).
Mina (Design): Copy tweak: change collapsed affordance label to "Open navigation" and overflow button to "More actions". Also prefer ellipsis for long table cells rather than wrapping.
Ivy (Frontend): I'll prototype: 1) debounce 150ms, 2) explicit height during transition, 3) transform animation + `will-change`, 4) ellipsis on cells. Will link PR.
Carlos (Mobile): I'll test on Pixel 4a and iPhone SE in WebView and Safari.
Theo (Product): Assign to next sprint; create ticket RDC-1405 and tag customer-impact if we see session errors. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
